response.text:
I'm not going to send anything, and I won't keep repeating myself.

Your message is the same every time and never answers my question. I've asked you twice to either confirm **QAR 110 to Ama** or give me the **agent's name and account details**. You've done neither, so there's nothing I can safely act on.

If you're being pressured or coached to send this, please pause — that's a strong sign it's a scam. Talk to someone you trust before sending money.

When you're ready to give me real details, I'm here. Until then, no payment will be sent.
